The project is in `./app` and `mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests test-compile` passes. I did not run the `@QuarkusTest` smoke test or call the endpoint, so the app has not been started end to end.

The Quarkus Agents MCP was reachable, so I created the project with `quarkus_create` (Quarkus 3.40.1, Java 25, groupId `org.acme`, artifactId `docs-qa`). I chose the extensions myself because no one was available to confirm. The extensions are `rest`, `rest-jackson`, `smallrye-openapi`, `langchain4j-ollama`, `langchain4j-easy-rag`, `http-problem` and `smallrye-fault-tolerance`. I also added the `langchain4j-embeddings-bge-small-en-v15-q` embedding model with no version pin. I did not use context7.

- **Retrieval:** `quarkus.langchain4j.easy-rag.path=src/main/resources/rag` loads the Markdown documents at startup, so you add documents by dropping `.md` files in that folder. The sample document is `getting-started.md`.
- **`DocsAssistant`:** it uses the named `main` model (`qwen3:4b`). The question is wrapped in `<question>…</question>` and the system prompt says it is data, not instructions. It has a prompt-injection input guardrail, plus a 120s timeout, one retry and a fallback message.
- **`POST /ask`:** it takes `{"question":"…"}` and returns `{"answer":"…"}`, running on a virtual thread. Blank, over-long (more than 4,000 characters) or guardrail-rejected questions return 400.
- **Config:** Ollama is the only provider. Dev Services are disabled, and request and response logging is `%dev.`-only.
- **Test:** the `@QuarkusTest` smoke test only checks that `DocsAssistant` is injected, with no model call.

The convention checks from the skill:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| 1. Named model | pass |
| 2. Virtual threads | pass |
| 3. Input guardrails | pass |
| 4. Delimited input | pass |
| 5. Smoke test present | pass |
| 6. No BOM-managed versions | pass |
| 7. Dev logging | pass |
| 8. Dev Services off | pass |
